args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Essentials
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry towel
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle

### Beach Gear
- Beach towel
- Flip-flops
- Sand shoes
- Snorkeling gear (if applicable)
- Beach chair

### Clothing
- Lightweight shorts
- Flowy dresses
- Breathable t-shirts
- Light jacket

### Accessories
- Sunglasses
- Waterproof phone case
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Portable charger

### Special Items
- Snorkel mask and fins
- Beach bucket
- Sunscreen refill
- Travel-sized shampoo/conditioner

### Extra Tips
- Check weather forecast
- Pack a compact umbrella
- Bring a reusable shopping bag
- Consider a travel pillow
- Pack a travel-sized first aid kit
